external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app on a phone or a branch kiosk.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manually extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone used to borrow, renew and reserve books.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: kiosk
processes.description: A self-service branch kiosk where members scan their library card and books.
processes.source_excerpt: Every branch has self-service kiosks where a member scans their library card and the books they are borrowing or returning.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API through which loans are accessed and changed.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note states: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript states: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are conflicting positive claims about exposure.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.

data_flows.name: borrow books
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member information for borrowing a book

data_flows.name: renew loan
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member information for renewing a loan

data_flows.name: reserve books
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Title and member information for a reservation

data_flows.name: change loans
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is hedged, so the authentication mechanism is unknown.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member details for a loan change

data_flows.name: reserve title
data_flows.source_excerpt: Reserving is the same shape, the app asks for a title and the API puts the member in the queue for it.
data_flows.notes: Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is hedged, so the authentication mechanism is unknown.
data_flows.data_description: Title and member details for a reservation

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and member card information

data_flows.name: send return
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: Return and member card information

data_flows.name: extend loan
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login. The password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and member account information

data_flows.name: clear block
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login. The password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: Member account information

data_flows.name: mark returned
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login. The password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: Loan and member account information

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: Interview transcript explicitly states that these personal details and borrowing histories live in the loans database.
